scenarios.name: publish_delivers_to_active_subscriber
scenarios.note: In-process: a payload published after a subscribe reaches that live subscriber. Durability and cross-process delivery are caveats(), out of the matrix.

scenarios.name: namespace_isolation_blocks_delivery
scenarios.note: A subscriber in namespace app-a must not receive a publish made in namespace app-b; the receive bounded-waits and reports a timeout instead of hanging.
